text:
ana (PM): Quick sync: Customer X requests a 90-day 'softcap grace' on committed tiers where overages become platform credits (no cash refunds) and a limited SLA penalty carveout. Need product/legal/billing/ops input.
kevin (sales): Credits are their ask for accounting reasons. If we agree, good renewal signal.
li (eng): Implementation sketch: add `grace_period_end` to commit metadata and track `soft_overage` ledger entries. Question: scope per-commit vs global account? Recommend per-commit. Potential perf note: prefix caching and burst lanes make fine-grained accounting trickier.
sophie (legal): Credits okay with explicit opt-in. Must be non-transferable, non-refundable, expire (12 months), and include a dispute window (30 days) before conversion. Need notice at commit time.
omar (revops): Billing options: (A) mark overages to a `soft_overage` ledger then convert after dispute window, or (B) delay invoices until grace ends. Prefer A for auditability. We'll add `credit_scope` field.
julian (prodops): SLA ask: reduced penalty floors while in grace and explicit QoS: soft_overage traffic best-effort. Prefer a templated 'grace SLA' rather than bespoke documents.
carrie (cs): Console must show credit pool, pending conversions, and expiry; add CSV export for finance.
kevin (sales): Customer asks for pilot next month. Can we scope pilot to one account and limit surface area?
li (eng): Yes: pilot constraints: single-customer, credits-only, per-commit scope, templated SLA. I'll provide an estimate by EOD Fri.
sophie (legal): I'll draft contract language and opt-in checkbox wording by Mon.
omar (revops): I'll outline ledger changes and accounting treatment by Mon.
julian (prodops): I'll prepare SLA template and capacity-deprioritization note by Mon.
carrie (cs): I'll mock Console card and CSV sample by Thu.
ana (typo removed).
ana noise cleaned.
ana ignore.
(removed stray text)
ana done.

Decision checkpoint: propose pilot defaults: credits-only, per-commit scope, soft_overage ledger with 30-day dispute period, credits expire at 12 months, templated grace SLA, Console visibility. Proceed unless objections by EOD tomorrow.
(End of thread)
